headword: {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}

definitions.explanation: The official bodies responsible for criminal investigations, including the police and prosecutors. A formal term commonly used in news reporting.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}き{出|だ}した→動き出す：18597_ugokidasu⟧。
examples.english: The investigative authorities have started to act.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにしていない→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧。
examples.english: The investigative authorities have not disclosed the details of the case.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{否認|ひにん}している→否認する：22511_hininsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: According to the investigative authorities, the suspect is denying the charges.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term found almost exclusively in news reports and legal contexts. Reporters use this term when they do not specify whether the source is police or prosecutors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧ (according to investigative authorities)
- {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ (authorities advance the investigation)
- {捜査|そうさ}{当局|とうきょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧ (announcement by investigative authorities)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧: police — more specific and everyday
- ⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧: prosecutors — the branch that decides whether to indict
- ⟦{当局|とうきょく}→当局：12540_toukyoku⟧: authorities — more general, not limited to criminal investigation
